meta.title: Weiming HPC
meta.description: Logs in to the Peking University Weiming cluster (wm1-data, wm1-login, wm2-data, wm2-login) over SSH with a password and a TOTP code, and exposes the wm_server_status, wm_server_setup, and wm_server_run tools. Every call checks ~/.config/wm2/credentials.json first; when credentials are missing it returns the acquisition steps instead of attempting a login: open the HPC one-time-password binding page, scan the QR code with WeChat, copy the resulting text (otpauth://...), then pass that text and the account password to wm_server_setup. Secrets are written to that file with mode 600 and are never echoed; tools return only a key fingerprint. Each credential is submitted at most once per connection, and the plugin does not transfer files.
